company.name: Surfshark
company.shortDescription: A private internet connection (VPN) for an unlimited number of devices, with optional antivirus and personal-data removal.
company.planHelp: Sign in at surfshark.com and open your account page. Look for 'Subscription' or 'Plan' to see which plan you have, what you pay and when it renews.

sources.title: Surfshark VPN plans explained: Starter vs. One vs. One+ (official blog, includes full price table)
What are Surfshark subscription plan options? (official support)

features.label: Devices protected at the same time
features.question: How many devices (phones, computers, and tablets) do you want to protect?
features.help: Unlimited. Every Surfshark plan covers as many devices as you like at the same time, so the whole family is covered.

features.label: Virus protection
features.question: Do you want virus protection for your computer as well?
features.help: The cheapest plan does not include it.

features.label: Warning if your details are stolen
features.question: Do you want to be told if your email address or card details turn up on a criminal website?

features.label: A stand-in name and email address
features.question: Would you like a stand-in email address to give to shops and websites, so your real one stays private?
features.help: Surfshark calls this "Alternative ID". It is included on every plan.

features.label: Removing your details from data-selling companies
features.question: Would you like a service that asks companies to delete the personal information they hold about you?
features.help: Surfshark calls this "Incogni". Only the most expensive plan includes it.

features.label: Coverage if someone steals your identity
features.question: Do you want coverage and help if someone pretends to be you?
features.help: Only the most expensive plan includes this, and only for eligible customers in the United States.

plans.name: Surfshark Starter
plans.bestFor: Someone who just wants a private internet connection for as many devices as they own.
plans.notes: Month-by-month price $16.45 and 12-month price $3.39/month are taken from the price table in Surfshark's own blog article 'Surfshark VPN plans explained'. The annual figure of $40.68 is 12 x $3.39 calculated from that per-month rate; Surfshark does not publish a yearly total or a renewal price, so this plan is marked uncertain. PROMOTIONAL ONLY: the pricing page advertises $67.23 for the first 27 months (24 months + 3 free), shown as $2.49/month. Includes VPN, unlimited devices, Dynamic MultiHop, Bypasser, CleanWeb ad blocker, rotating IP and Alternative ID.

plans.name: Surfshark One
plans.bestFor: Most people: private internet plus virus protection and a warning if your details are leaked.
plans.notes: Month-by-month price $18.95 and 12-month price $3.59/month from Surfshark's official plans blog table. The $43.08 annual figure is 12 x $3.59; Surfshark publishes no yearly total or renewal price, so marked uncertain. PROMOTIONAL ONLY: $75.33 for the first 27 months ($2.79/month) on the pricing page. Adds Surfshark Antivirus with real-time protection, Surfshark Alert, scam protection for email and text, and content filtering.

plans.name: Surfshark One+
plans.bestFor: Someone who also wants their personal details removed from the companies that buy and sell them.
plans.notes: Month-by-month price $21.85 and 12-month price $7.49/month from Surfshark's official plans blog table. The $89.88 annual figure is 12 x $7.49; no yearly total or renewal price is published, so marked uncertain. PROMOTIONAL ONLY: $121.23 for the first 27 months ($4.49/month). Adds Incogni personal-data removal and identity theft coverage for eligible US customers.

faq.q: How many devices can I use with one Surfshark subscription?
faq.a: As many as you like. All three plans allow unlimited devices at the same time, so one subscription can cover the whole household.

faq.q: Why is the advertised price so much lower than the monthly price?
faq.a: The headline price is for a 2-year introductory deal paid all at once. Paying month by month costs far more, and after the introductory term the subscription renews at Surfshark's standard price.

faq.q: What is the difference between One and One+?
faq.a: One+ adds Incogni, a service that contacts data-selling companies and asks them to delete the information they hold about you, plus identity theft coverage for eligible US customers.
Surfshark advertises a 30-day money-back guarantee on all plans, and a 7-day free trial through the mobile app stores.

notes: Prices come from the price table published in Surfshark's own blog article 'Surfshark VPN plans explained' (24-month, 12-month and 1-month columns), because the Surfshark pricing page itself only renders the 24-month introductory offer. CONFLICT NOTED: a separate official Surfshark blog article, 'VPN cost: how can you save?', gives a single monthly figure of $15.45 and a 1-year figure of $3.19/month without saying which plan those refer to, so the exact monthly prices should be re-checked at purchase. Surfshark does not publish renewal prices anywhere public; its terms only say 'Upon renewal, you will be charged the applicable renewal price'. All annual amounts here are the advertised 12-month per-month rate multiplied by 12 and are likely to be introductory. Dedicated IP and Alternative Number are paid add-ons on any plan.
